svg.text: Replaces the whole app when the stored identity can

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: never be opened again: Android invalidated its key, the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: key is missing, or the file fails its check. The app

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: never makes a new identity over it on its own.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Erase identity asks first, with the usual confirmation,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: then destroys the key and opens Welcome as a new node.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Messages and peers stay in the store.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The detail is the error Android reported, monospace

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: and selectable; Copy details puts it on the clipboard

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: (a snackbar confirms on Android 12, the system does on

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 13 and later). The text scrolls at large font scales.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: With debug staging on, Erase identity is left out.
